description: Accessify Play provides comprehensive NVDA control for Spotify playback on any Connect-enabled device. A Spotify Premium subscription is required for full functionality.
changelog:
- Fixed: signing in failed with "redirect_uri: Not matching configuration", and had to be finished within 10 seconds.
- New: a Sign-in port setting, and the Redirect URI for your own Client ID shown in the settings.
- Search: Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+6 and Ctrl+Tab switch the type and search again; Ctrl+F returns to the search field.
- Artist window: opens on Top Tracks, with a new Playlists found by name tab.
- Every list has the same context menu, Enter and row format; long lists load a page at a time.
- Every shortcut inside the windows can be changed (Window Shortcuts... in the settings), and there are new settings.
- Many bug fixes; see the changelog for the full list.

translations.description: Accessify Play memberikan kontrol NVDA komprehensif untuk pemutaran Spotify di perangkat apa pun yang mendukung Spotify Connect. Langganan Spotify Premium diperlukan untuk fungsionalitas penuh.
translations.changelog:
- Diperbaiki: proses masuk gagal dengan "redirect_uri: Not matching configuration", dan harus selesai dalam 10 detik.
- Baru: pengaturan port masuk, dan Redirect URI untuk Client ID sendiri ditampilkan di pengaturan.
- Pencarian: Ctrl+1 sampai Ctrl+6 dan Ctrl+Tab mengganti jenis dan langsung mencari lagi; Ctrl+F kembali ke kolom pencarian.
- Jendela artis: terbuka di Top Tracks, dengan tab baru Daftar Putar berdasarkan nama.
- Setiap daftar punya menu konteks, Enter, dan format baris yang sama; daftar panjang dimuat per halaman.
- Setiap pintasan di dalam jendela bisa diubah (Window Shortcuts... di pengaturan), dan ada pengaturan baru.
- Banyak perbaikan bug; lihat changelog untuk daftar lengkapnya.
